basis: User-requested schematic street-clearance correction: translate individual source footprints locally; separate merged block footprints along street corridors. Not surveyed historical locations.

clearance_policy.stroke_radius: upstream radius 0/1 plus sqrt(2) floor-sampling allowance and 0.5 pixel margin
clearance_policy.merged_footprints: Separate only oversized merged source footprints that have no nearby intact placement; retain original source IDs and provenance.

structure_policy.modern_geometry: Explicitly reviewed surviving structure with historical footprint overlap and documentary support only; no proximity-only or automatic nearest-building substitution. Import no modern surroundings.

excluded_examples.reason: Old Sessions House has a large 1990s extension; retain the historical outline. Council planning agenda 2 April 2024, paragraph 22.
Nearest historical source candidate is labelled St Martin’s Priory; church-to-footprint identity is not established.
Nearest historical source candidate is labelled Church Hall; church-to-footprint identity is not established.
Castle Street multi-storey car park: modern replacement is not the historical structure despite strong footprint overlap.
St George tower cannot substitute for the complete church present in 1940 and destroyed in 1942.

structure_policy.unknown_identity: Retain historical structure; geometric overlap alone is insufficient.
structure_policy.historical_cleanup: Topology-preserving simplification at at most 0.7 source pixels; area change at most max(0.6 pixel squared,12 percent). Reject any new street, building, water or rail obstruction.
structure_policy.modern_alignment: Local translation only, no modern-footprint resize, rotation or street clipping; retain explicit schematic offset.

structure_refinements.name: Hothe Court
structure_refinements.basis: Named Hothe Court footprint overlaps the historical source with the same modern identity; Historic England describes its surviving C16-or-earlier T-shaped house and older wings. Use that principal house outline alone; import no surrounding modern structures. Registration and local street-clearance offset remain schematic, not surveyed historical coordinates.
